answer: Yes. Name the category in `[discussions] answer_categories` of `.github/issue-assistant/config.toml`, such as `answer_categories = ["Q&A"]`, and run `install` of your release again: it then writes `.github/workflows/discussion-assistant.yml`, the only workflow that may write to discussions. Each new discussion of that category gets one first answer, checked as every analysis, which the asker may mark as the answer.

references.reason: How a new discussion gets its first answer, and which settings turn it on.
